episode_title: Why It's Likely You're Overpaying On Your Mortgage with Daniel Marks [CPD Available]

real_qa.q: Can a newly qualified dentist on foundation year salary get a mortgage in the UK?
real_qa.r: Yes, if you are in your foundation year earning around 42,000 pounds, you can get a mortgage based on your current employment contract and pay slip without needing to wait. Many lenders are happy with a one-year contract from your foundation position.

real_qa.q: How soon can a newly self-employed associate dentist apply for a mortgage after starting practice?
real_qa.r: Some lenders will accept as few as three pay schedules into your first associate position, and by April after starting in September you can file your first self-assessment which includes both foundation employment income and self-employed associate income, unlocking high street lending options.
real_qa.requete: self-employed dentist mortgage three pay schedules

real_qa.q: What deposit options are available for dentists buying residential property with limited savings?
real_qa.r: Some lenders offer 5% deposit mortgages, and there are recent high street bank products where you only need a 5,000 pounds deposit to borrow up to 99% loan-to-value, allowing you to buy a 500,000 pounds property with just 5,000 pounds down. Some lenders also offer 0% deposit options for those with a year of accounts.
real_qa.requete: low deposit mortgage UK dentist 5 percent

real_qa.q: What are the risks of 99% loan-to-value mortgages for dentist property buyers?
real_qa.r: The main risk is going into negative equity if the property market declines in your local area. At remortgage time, you might become stuck with your original lender because you cannot remortgage to a lower loan-to-value elsewhere.
real_qa.requete: negative equity high loan to value mortgage risk

real_qa.q: Why do mortgage lenders treat newly qualified dentists differently from other self-employed professionals?
real_qa.r: Lenders recognize that dentists have a typical career path with exponential earnings growth, meaning what you earn in year one is not what you earn in year five. They know you have undergone at least five years of university plus one year of foundation training before becoming self-employed, so they are willing to take on more risk without a lengthy self-employment history.
real_qa.requete: dentist mortgage lenders professional qualification path
